query: For an IV-HG500CA reporting that its sensor program is damaged and initialization is necessary, what caused the condition, and what causes VS Series Error 30109?
source_title: IV-HG500CA and VS Series troubleshooting manuals
expected_snippet: The IV-HG500CA condition is associated with a memory read error at startup, a data problem while running the program, or power loss/noise during writing. VS Series Error 30109 occurs when a subtask is executed from the main screen while multiple subtasks are selected.

expected_evidence.snippet: Column headers: Cause; Row headers: Sensor program damaged. Initialization necessary.; Cell value: A memory read error occurred when the sensor started; a data trouble occurred during program execution; power may have been switched off during writing, or noise was picked up.
Error Code: 30109; Message: Cannot execute when multiple subtasks are selected.; Cause: An attempt was made to execute a subtask from the main screen while multiple subtasks are selected.
